'''DSD-1 torture droids''' were [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droids]] employed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]]. They appeared as hovering balls adorned with syringes, claws, and electrical prods, similar to [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droids. They were employed by the Qrephs to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] their prisoners, and in [[45 ABY]], they used a DSD-1 to torture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Ohali Soroc]], [[Ohali Two]], and [[Barduun]] during a warmped [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game where the players bet information and pain instead of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
